services.desc: Home → Fisheries → Maine Saltwater Recreational Fishing → Maine Saltwater Recreational Fishing - Opportunities to Participate → Volunteer Angler Logbook Program The Volunteer Angler Logbook (VAL) program collects length, catch & effort data from saltwater anglers to inform the management of Maine’s fish populations. It is primarily geared toward striped bass anglers, but it is open to anglers who fish for any saltwater species.
